summary: Iteration 35 - Tested Stripe Payment Integration for Kirmes Billing System. All 16 backend API tests passed. Fixed a bug in PUT /api/payments/deposits/config endpoint (body parameter parsing). Frontend UI verified for signup flow showing deposit amounts, payment step with 'Jetzt bezahlen' button, 'Später bezahlen' skip button, and payment return URL handling with status polling.
